readerCopy.headline: The opportunity arrives with a limit attached.
readerCopy.body:
You may want the larger plan and discover that one part of it is not negotiable. The budget is fixed. The approval takes longer. An existing responsibility still needs the same hours. The opportunity can be real and still arrive inside conditions you would not have chosen.

Jupiter square Saturn makes more and not yet show up together. Work with the actual limit instead of arguing with its existence. If the budget is fixed, the scope has to move. If the time is fixed, something else comes off the calendar. A delay can be information about the structure the plan needs.
doNotAssume: Do not assume failure, rejection, financial hardship, or that the opportunity should be abandoned.
